title: Patronin: primary sequence versus condensation
objective: Distinguish native sequence recognition from a transferable condensation/assembly role of an operational Q/N-rich Patronin segment using literature published before 2026-01-01.
coordinate_note: Native numbering is A1ZAU8 sequence version 1 (1630 aa). Candidate PrLD 713–1038 is an explicit operational hypothesis, not a literature-validated domain. Exact native flanks remain adjacent to each cassette, without added linker residues. All sequences are complete tag-free assay polypeptides; no unspecified purification tag or fluorescent protein is implied. Current UniRef comparisons are sequence analyses, not pre-cutoff publications. Conservation uses present-day sequence clusters and is not a historical reconstruction: Patronin 509 aligned rows, Neff 5.16; hnRNPA1 23 aligned rows, Neff 1.01. UniRef50 membership is not proof of orthology. Scores indicate weak independent support and do not determine necessity.

sources.title: Regulation of microtubule minus-end dynamics by CAMSAPs and Patronin
sources.coverage: Title and identifiers checked on PMC and PubMed. Abstract, Patronin Results, Figure 5 legend and discussion inspected via search-indexed full-text passages. Figure S2 conclusions read in Results; SI PDF not inspected. Exact A1ZAU8 PrLD boundary is not established by this paper.

sources.title: Phase separation by low complexity domains promotes stress granule assembly and drives pathological fibrillization
sources.coverage: PMC title and identifier checked; summary, introduction, liquid droplet Results, Figure 1 and LCD findings inspected. Supplement sequences not inspected; donor letters taken from UniProt isoform FASTA. Supports hnRNPA1 LCD condensation, not Patronin chimera rescue.

sources.title: Valence and patterning of aromatic residues determine the phase behavior of prion-like domains
sources.coverage: PMC title/DOI checked. Abstract, Figure 1 and indexed Results/Figure 4 passages on sticker valence, patterning and aggregation inspected. Figure S2 note on removal of a steric zipper read in main text; full SI not inspected. Our complete F/Y/W-to-S cassettes are new operational controls, not claimed copies of published Aro-minus variants.

sources.title: CAMSAP2 organizes a γ-tubulin-independent microtubule nucleation centre through phase separation
sources.coverage: Title/DOI checked on eLife and PubMed. Abstract, CAMSAP2 construct Results and Figure 3 co-condensation Results/legend inspected on eLife mirror and PMC indexed passages. Does not establish Patronin PrLD boundaries or direct minus-end targeting by an IDR.

sources.title: Patronin regulates presynaptic microtubule organization and neuromuscular junction development in Drosophila
sources.coverage: PMC title/DOI checked; summary, introduction, domain-rescue figure description and Shot/NMJ conclusions inspected. No exact PrLD construct or condensation-specific experiment recovered. Supports retaining the N-terminal context and separating purified recognition from cell phenotypes.

sources.title: Patronin — UniProt A1ZAU8, sequence version 1
sources.coverage: REST JSON and FASTA retrieved; 1630 residues, sequence version 1 last changed 2007-02-06. Current functional annotations were not used as pre-2026 evidence.

sources.title: Heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein A1 — UniProt P09651 and isoform P09651-2

hypotheses.question: Does the operational Q/N-rich segment contribute to Patronin minus-end recognition?
hypotheses.mechanism: The candidate PrLD contributes either contacts, cooperative assembly or both.
hypotheses.measurement: WT versus segment deletion: end/lattice enrichment, end occupancy, residence time and phase behavior. Loss alone does not distinguish direct recognition from condensation.

hypotheses.question: Is spacer order necessary when composition and selected interaction patterns are held fixed?
hypotheses.mechanism: A native order-dependent interaction is disturbed by reordering nonaromatic spacers while preserving F/Y/W, charge and proline positions.
hypotheses.measurement: Compare scramble and WT only after establishing overlapping phase behavior in the same assay buffer. Retained condensation with lost end specificity supports an order-dependent contribution.

hypotheses.question: Does reducing native aromatic valence change assembly and end recognition together?
hypotheses.mechanism: F/Y/W-to-S may weaken multivalent contacts in the operational Patronin segment.
hypotheses.measurement: Measure coexistence/assembly and end recognition together. Loss of both is consistent with, but does not isolate, a condensation mechanism.

hypotheses.question: Can a different condensation-capable sequence replace the operational native segment?
hypotheses.mechanism: The native region supplies an assembly property that an unrelated hnRNPA1 LCD may supply in the same scaffold.
hypotheses.measurement: Compare A1-LCD swap with deletion, equal-length GS cassette and aromatic-depleted A1 swap at matched soluble concentrations. Rescue specific to the measurably condensing cassette supports a transferable assembly role.

hypotheses.question: Are condensation, end targeting and suppression of end dynamics separable?
hypotheses.mechanism: The CKK-containing C-terminal module collaborates with central recognition/assembly rather than serving as the sole end-targeting site.
hypotheses.measurement: Compare CKK-module deletion with WT for condensation, end tracking and suppression of minus-end growth. Residual targeting is expected to remain possible from the central region.

observations.finding: Patronin central fragment 868–1457 binds minus ends; the central region without CKK can track ends but does not suppress minus-end growth or rescue S2-cell treadmilling.

observations.context: Purified Drosophila Patronin truncations, TIRF/gliding assays and S2-cell UTR-directed RNAi rescue

rationale.uncertainty: The defined Q/N-rich segment has not been independently established as a PrLD before the cutoff.
rationale.inference: A punctum is not, by itself, evidence for phase separation.

rationale.comparison: Scramble versus WT at overlapping measured assembly state and soluble concentration.

method.homolog_source: UniRef50_A1ZAU8; 512 UniProtKB cluster members, not a curated ortholog set
method.comparison_set: UniProtKB members of UniRef50_A1ZAU8, the UniRef50 cluster containing A1ZAU8: the same protein in other species, clustered by UniProt at 50% identity with an 80% length-overlap requirement. ORTHOLOG level: scores answer what this protein needs.
method.alignment: multiple alignment by FAMSA via pyfamsa 0.7.0, projected onto reference coordinates by dropping columns where the reference is gapped. It can score positions that MAFFT leaves unscored, with weak support, so read per-position coverage alongside the score
method.weighting: Henikoff position-based sequence weights, computed over variable columns only
method.effective_sequences_definition: Neff = sum(1/n_i), n_i counting sequences at least 80% identical to sequence i over positions where both have a residue (itself included); pairs overlapping less than 50% of the reference are not counted as similar. Reported unnormalised and divided by reference length; normalisation is not standardised in the literature, so compare only against values computed the same way. This is NOT the sum of the Henikoff weights, which is rescaled to the sequence count by construction and therefore always equals it.
method.score: Jensen-Shannon divergence against Robinson & Robinson background, scaled by column occupancy (Capra & Singh 2007)

precedent_search.scope: Before candidate selection: separate primary-literature searches for Patronin truncations, PrLD, sequence order, condensation, CAMSAP2 phase separation, hnRNPA1 sticker valence and 2023–2025 Patronin/Shot developmental findings. Cutoff 2026-01-01; post-cutoff hits excluded from evidence and boundaries. Forward context checked through later Patronin domain and CAMSAP2 studies; no exact pre-cutoff Patronin PrLD-swap precedent recovered.
